category_title: Students with non-compliant behavior and difficulty accepting instructions or consequences
minimal_context: Garth is in the general classroom setting working on a teacher-selected spelling assignment involving writing definitions for 20 words.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Garth, it is time for spelling. I need you to write the definitions for these 20 words on your worksheet.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Makes loud noises by tapping his pencil on the desk) I'm not doing definitions.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please just get started on the words.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Turns his back) Shut up, I don't care.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Garth, that is not appropriate. You need to follow the instructions or there will be consequences.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Rips the spelling worksheet in half and knocks the textbook off the desk) No!

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Garth, it is time for spelling. I need you to write the definitions for these 20 words on your worksheet.

STUDENT: (Makes loud noises by tapping his pencil on the desk) I'm not doing definitions.

TUTOR: Please just get started on the words.

STUDENT: (Turns his back) Shut up, I don't care.

TUTOR: Garth, that is not appropriate. You need to follow the instructions or there will be consequences.

STUDENT: (Rips the spelling worksheet in half and knocks the textbook off the desk) No!

task.content: Spelling tasks (e.g., writing the word 3 times; writing definitions for 20 words)

context.environment: Independent work involving textbook and worksheet tasks or group activities

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: Adult initiation or when assignments were selected by the teacher and changing tasks was not permitted
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: No response or negative verbal or nonverbal response to adult initiation; non-compliant behavior and property destruction

behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Inappropriate verbal behavior toward staff and peers; non-compliant behavior and property destruction
Noise-making or off-task statements in academic context; off task behavior during academic activities
